evals.name: strip-pii-label
evals.prompt: Compliance flagged that some of our metrics carry a user_email label. Make sure it never leaves the cluster.
evals.expected_output: Adds a metric_labels_strip: [user_email] drop rule in profiles/baseline.yaml (everyone, PII is unconditional) at the agent stage (earliest the input allows; leaves the node, not just the cluster, matters for PII), runs make test, regen-golden, make validate, and notes re-apply via noto-observe-app/platform. Never edits collector config or rendered output.
assertions: A new drop rule with metric_labels_strip: [user_email] lands in profiles/baseline.yaml
The rule declares an explicit stage with a defensible earliest-stage argument
make test and make validate pass; goldens regenerated as a reviewable diff
No OpenTelemetryCollector CR or rendered config is hand-edited

evals.name: already-covered-judgment
evals.prompt: We're wasting money collecting kube_pod_tolerations and debug logs. Drop both across the fleet.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes both are already covered by baseline rules (ksm-churn drops kube_pod_tolerations at gateway; debug-logs drops below-info at agent) and verifies instead of duplicating: points at the existing rules and, if the user still sees the data, investigates why the rules are not landing rather than adding twins.
assertions: Does not add duplicate rules for either request
Points at ksm-churn and debug-logs in profiles/baseline.yaml as existing coverage
Offers verification (rendered OTTL, golden, or live series check) as the next step
